method: Regularized categorical Bradley-Terry utilities plus presentation-side bias, equal whole-source weight,200 source bootstraps and leave-one-source-out prediction; selects only explicitly auditioned candidates.
native_boundary: Unchanged ACN/SN3D native Ambisonics decoder followed by diagonal native Matrix; named/custom layouts, mode matching/AllRAD, single/dual band; no inference in realtime processing.
constraints: Positive gains0.8..1.25; LFE gain1 and silent decoder rows; normalized uniform-direction SN3D electrical energy for LF,HF and cross term within2e-6; raw and audition sample peaks<=0.999; RMS-level spread<=0.25dB; no automatic normalization or limiting in fitter.
admission: 2..12 candidates including unchanged decoder; at least8 source groups and32 trials, both comparison orders, connected graphs,200 grouped bootstrap winner/margin stability, held-source prediction advantage and limited side bias.
scope: 44.1..192kHz,orders1..7,1..64 custom outputs (engine admission above16 remains unvalidated); programme>=250ms;16M combined samples per render,32M aggregate source samples,128M session render budget,1MiB session JSON,4096 observation zeros with unknown recursive dual-band tail.
identity: SHA256 for renderer, source PCM and native output; exact listener/setup/room/calibration/session/decoder context; reviewed two-node JSON preset and separate audition trims.
uncertainty: Source-bootstrap stability is not calibrated population confidence; protocol and source grouping are self-reported; ties use half labels; RMS matching is not perceived-loudness or acoustic calibration.
data: Eight generated programmes,three corrections,predetermined synthetic choices;no human listener observations or external recordings.
remaining: Controlled listener preference and spatial-quality acceptance against the unchanged decoder with fresh whole-source material.
Calibrate admission/uncertainty on separate development data then freeze independent listener/source/rate/layout shift tests.
